# Urban Investors

> Urban Investors is a luxury real estate advisory based in Noida, India, serving high-net-worth clients across Delhi NCR and the Yamuna Expressway since 2017. We curate premium residential and commercial property investments with a focus on transparency, market research, and long-term ROI.

## Research & Market Intelligence (Insights & News)

- [Commercial Offices vs High-Street Retail: Noida Yield & Capital ROI Analysis](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/commercial-offices-vs-high-street-retail-noida): Comparative underwriting guide analyzing Sector 140A IT/ITES office towers (CRC The Flagship, Fairfox EON) versus lockable high-street retail, gross (6.5%–9.0%) vs realistic net yields (5.2%–6.8%), footfall dynamics, vacancy buffers, and liquidity.
- [NRI Guide to Indian Real Estate: FEMA Regulations, Repatriation & Capital Gains](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/nri-guide-indian-real-estate): Practical regulatory and taxation manual for Non-Resident Indians purchasing property in Noida, covering FEMA eligibility, NRE vs NRO accounts, Section 195 TDS (20% + surcharge), Section 197 lower deduction certificates, 12.5% LTCG, $1M annual repatriation limits, and consular Power of Attorney.
- [Noida vs Gurgaon in 2026: Ultra-HNWI Capital Allocation](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/noida-vs-gurgaon-real-estate-2026): Institutional comparison of Noida Expressway and Gurugram across price per square foot (₹14,000–₹24,000 vs ₹22,000–₹45,000+), rental yields (3.2%–4.2% vs 2.6%–3.4%), infrastructure runways (operational Jewar Airport flights vs IGI), and capital preservation vs growth profiles.
- [Noida Metro Extension & Jewar Airport in 2026: Real Estate Impact](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/noida-metro-jewar-airport-property-impact-2026): Research-backed analysis of the Cabinet-approved 11.56 km Sector 142–Botanical Garden Metro extension (approved 14 Feb 2026), operational commercial flights at Noida International Airport Jewar (commenced 15 June 2026), station alignments, realistic delivery timelines, and property due diligence for Noida & Yamuna Expressway buyers.
- [Yamuna Expressway Master Plan 2031 Explained](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/yamuna-expressway-master-plan-2031): Research-based regional development guide breaking down the YEIDA Phase I 2031 Master Plan (approved 2013), industrial and employment clusters (Vivo, Patanjali, Medical Device Park), Jewar Airport transit links, 2031 vs 2041 planning evolution, and due diligence criteria for property buyers.
- [Hero Homes Leafsong Retreat Investment Analysis](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/hero-homes-leafsong-retreat-investment-analysis): Institutional review of Hero Realty's low-density 3 BHK community in Sector MU Greater Noida, pricing from ₹1.90 Cr*, Morphogenesis biophilic master plan, UP RERA UPRERAPRJ414014/10/2026, and Pari Chowk/Jewar Airport growth drivers.
- [Godrej Global Business City Investment Analysis](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/godrej-global-business-city-investment-analysis): Comprehensive 2026 analysis of Godrej Global Business City in Greater Noida, 750-acre DMIC township integration, and price trends.
- [Top 10 Luxury Projects in Noida](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/top-luxury-projects-noida): Definitive 2026 rankings, price appreciation trends, and RERA analysis for luxury apartments in Noida.
- [Yamuna Expressway Investment Guide](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/yamuna-expressway-investment-guide): Jewar Airport economic impact, Film City, industrial corridor progress, and 5-year capital appreciation forecasts.
- [Sector 150 Noida Real Estate Analysis](https://urbaninvestors.in/insights/sector-150-noida-real-estate-guide): In-depth guide to Noida's Sports City, 80% green coverage master plan, low-density zoning, and premier project reviews.

- [Prestige Sector 150 Noida](https://urbaninvestors.in/prestige-sector-150-noida.html): Luxury 2, 3 & 4 BHK apartments in Sector 150 Sports City, Noida starting at ₹2.48 Cr*.
